content.title: RR vs RCB Highlights, IPL 2026: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's fire and Dhruv Jurel's ice seals 6-wicket win
content.text: IPL 2026RR vs RCB, Highlights IPL 2026 Match Today: Dhruv Jurel seals the chase with an unbeaten 81 as RR make it four wins in a row. A composed knock under pressure caps off a dominant run for Riyan Parag’s side.RR vs RCB, IPL 2026 Live Score (Image: Reuters) Hello and welcome to our live coverage of Match 16 of the Indian Premier League 2026 (IPL 2026) where the Rajasthan Royals take on the Royal Challengers Bengaluru at the Baraspara Stadium in Guwahati on Friday, April 10. Apr 11, 2026 00:05 ISTIPL Live: RR win by 6 wicketsThere it is! Dhruv Jurel finishes it off in style, striking the winning runs and sealing another clinical chase for Rajasthan Royals. He remains unbeaten on 81, capping off a superb innings at No. 3 and guiding RR to their fourth win in a row. Brilliant performance from Riyan Parag’s side. Apr 11, 2026 00:02 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Did RCB miss a trick here?Feels like RCB may have missed a trick here by sticking with Abhinandan Singh. On a surface offering some grip, Suyash Sharma could have been a better option. Bringing in Venkatesh Iyer as the impact sub might have added more balance as well. In hindsight, this call could prove costly. Apr 11, 2026 00:01 ISTRR vs RCB Live: Has Jurel injured himself?Oh no, has Dhruv Jurel pulled up here? It looks like he’s struggling with cramps in the middle. That’s the last thing RR need at this stage. They’ll be hoping it’s nothing serious and that he can carry on to see this chase through. Apr 10, 2026 23:56 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Unreal from Vaibhav SooryavanshiUnreal hitting from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi! He’s absolutely torn RCB apart, smashing 78 off just 26 balls at a staggering strike rate of 300. 74 of those runs coming in boundaries alone tells you everything about the kind of innings this has been. Pure domination. Apr 10, 2026 23:51 ISTRR vs RCB Live: Is this the end?Looks like RCB have exhausted their options at the moment. Bhuvneshwar Kumar has the one over left. Romario Shepherd is into the attack. 7 runs in the over and it looks like it is more or less a formality to see the chase through to the end now.Apr 10, 2026 23:44 ISTIPL Live: Is that the game?Oh no, is that the game slipping away for RCB? Dhruv Jurel takes on Abhinandan Singh, smashing two boundaries in the over. One of them flies off a thick edge past the keeper. A tough chance for Jitesh Sharma, but that could have completely changed the game. Apr 10, 2026 23:35 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Jadeja risking it allWhat is Ravindra Jadeja trying to do here? Krunal Pandya keeps banging it in short, and Jadeja goes for the ramp before trying to pull the next one. He’s lucky neither found a fielder. Krunal looks visibly frustrated as Jadeja continues to flirt with risk. Apr 10, 2026 23:29 ISTIPL Live: Can Jadeja and Jurel take RR home?The required rate is dropping steadily now. It’s been well below the asking rate since that flurry of wickets. That said, these two need to take responsibility and see this through. Ravindra Jadeja doesn’t need to force the big shots, while Dhruv Jurel has looked solid. Just a matter of keeping the scoreboard ticking. Apr 10, 2026 23:22 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Riyan Parag throws his wicket awayOh no! Riyan Parag, what have you done? As captain, he needed to show a bit more responsibility. With the asking rate just over a run-a-ball, there was no need to force it. But he goes for the big shot and ends up finding the fielder in the deep. A massive moment in the game. Apr 10, 2026 23:14 ISTRR Live Score: Krunal Pandya does a madnessWhat do we have here! Shimron Hetmyer promoted to No. 4, but it hasn’t worked out. Krunal Pandya goes with the cheeky short ball, Hetmyer attempts a loose upper cut and ends up gifting a catch. That’s a poor shot from the West Indies star. RCB might still be down, but they’re certainly not out of this just yet. Apr 10, 2026 23:13 ISTRR Live Score: Sooryavanshi storm endsVaibhav Sooryavanshi’s sensational knock comes to an end, and it’s a touch fortunate for Krunal Pandya, who gets the breakthrough. RCB still have a mountain to climb from here, but they don’t look like a side that’s going to go down without a fight. Apr 10, 2026 23:09 ISTRR vs RCB Live: No mercy from SooryavanshiRCB are getting a bit desperate here. They’ve turned to Tim David’s off-spin, which isn’t too surprising given the absence of Suyash Sharma. But Vaibhav Sooryavanshi isn’t easing up either. He’s taking the attack to him as well, and at this rate, you have to wonder just how quickly this chase will be wrapped up. Apr 10, 2026 23:05 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Jurel now comes to the partyWith Vaibhav Sooryavanshi taking down bowlers for fun, it has really relieved the pressure of Dhruv Jurel as well. Some fine shots by the No.3 as well to keep the momentum going. Question is what RCB are going to do now with the fielding restrictions now removed. Apr 10, 2026 22:58 ISTIPL Live: Blazing fifty from SooryavanshiAnother over of sheer class from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. He’s taking on everyone, no matter who’s bowling, even the very best in the business. He brings up a breathtaking 15-ball fifty, making it look effortless. At this point, you have to wonder, what more does this kid have to prove? Apr 10, 2026 22:51 ISTIPL 2026 Live: Sooryavanshi storm engulfs GuwahatiThis is absolutely outrageous from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. He took on Abhinandan Singh with ease, smashing two boundaries and a six, but what followed against Josh Hazlewood was simply unthinkable. Sooryavanshi tore into one of the best bowlers in the world, picking up three boundaries in a row before topping it off with a stunning six. Hitting Hazlewood for fun like this is incredible to watch. Apr 10, 2026 22:43 ISTRR vs RCB Live: Hazlewood is back!What a start for Josh Hazlewood, exactly what RCB would have hoped for. Yashasvi Jaiswal went chasing a delivery he didn’t need to play, only to edge it through to the keeper. Even Jitesh Sharma looked a bit surprised by how comfortably that carried through. Yashasvi Jaiswal 13(8) c Jitesh Sharma b Josh Hazlewood RR vs RCB, IPL 2026 Live Score: (RR 21/1 in 1.6 ov) Apr 10, 2026 22:23 ISTRR vs RCB live: Have RCB got enough?A rollercoaster innings from RCB. It started fast, with Archer and Burger getting the ball to move, but the batters still managed to find boundaries. Then things went downhill quickly as wickets kept falling, leaving them at 125/7 in 14 overs and forcing the Impact Player move. Rajat Patidar then stepped up with a brilliant knock to steady things, and Venkatesh Iyer added some useful runs at the end to take RCB to a decent total. RCB will be pretty happy with the total they've managed to put on the board. Most 200-plus totals in the IPL 37 - CSK 37 - RCB* 33 - PBKS 32 - MI 30 - KKR Apr 10, 2026 22:19 ISTRR vs RCB live: Venky Iyer pushes RCB past 200 Venkatesh Iyer capped off a superb cameo, smashing a six off the final ball to take RCB past the 200-run mark and finish with a flourish. Walking in as the Impact Sub, he turned the last over into a costly one, starting with a cheeky reverse-lap four and then launching a clean hit over deep mid-wicket. Despite a couple of dots, Iyer kept the pressure on, picking up twos and punishing anything loose as Sandeep Sharma leaked 21 runs in the over, making Riyan Parag’s call to hand him the final over an expensive one.Apr 10, 2026 22:16 ISTRR vs RCB live: Venky Iyer gets going in final overVenkatesh Iyer showed his worth as the Impact Sub with a handy burst in the final over. He started with a clever reverse lap that raced away for four, catching the field off guard, and then followed it up by picking a length ball in the slot and sending it over deep mid-wicket for six. Apr 10, 2026 22:13 ISTRR vs RCB live: Venkatesh struggles as Bhuvi gets a boundaryVenkatesh Iyer is finding it tough to get going at this stage, struggling to middle the ball as Brijesh Sharma keeps things tight with clever variations. A miscued cut and a couple of quiet singles reflect the pressure building, but Bhuvneshwar Kumar brings a bit of relief for RCB with a cracking boundary. Given some width outside off, Bhuvneshwar frees his arms and thumps it over covers, injecting some much-needed momentum into the innings. Despite that, RR will feel they’ve kept things largely under control in this phase, with Venkatesh unable to break free.Load More
